# Turn a PayPal activity report into a Xero or QuickBooks journal

> Free PayPal activity report to journal converter: proves the Balance column is continuous, splits sales, fees, refunds, disputes and bank transfers by month, and downloads a balanced journal for Xero, QuickBooks Online or QuickBooks Desktop. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
